title: Llm Mycelium Interface
definition: A cognitive agent that serves as an interface between natural language queries and a content-addressed knowledge base, using local LLM models for responses.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine Willie as a smart assistant who reads and understands the CADMIES library and can answer your questions in plain English.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: LLM Mycelium Interface is an agent that queries local Ollama models with context from the CADMIES mycelium to provide informed responses.
difficulty_levels.expert: IPLD-based cognitive agent extending AgentNode schema with LLM bridge capabilities. It uses Ollama API to provide natural language access to the content-addressed mycelium, with concept retrieval, context assembly, and model selection.

extra_fields.insight: The LLM Mycelium Interface illustrates the potential for using IPLD and LLM models to create a bridge between natural language and content-addressed knowledge.
